briefings.title: How to upskill for an AI Age: Workera CEO Kian Katanforoosh
briefings.tldr: Leaders consistently overestimate their own and their teams' skills, creating significant gaps and hindering AI adoption, while skills rapidly become obsolete; Workera CEO Kian Katanforoosh advocates for AI-powered skill measurement to foster self-awareness, enable fair talent decisions, and cultivate adaptable, growth-oriented leadership.
